rubric.role_summary: Enterprise SaaS sales role focused on winning new accounts in Eastern and Central time zones, managing the full sales cycle from pipeline generation to close, and handling limited expansion and upsell.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Enterprise SaaS sales role focused on winning new accounts in Eastern and Central time zones, managing the full sales cycle from pipeline generation to close, and handling limited expansion and upsell.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Multi-year experience selling complex SaaS technologies to large organizations.
Explicit disqualifiers:
- Focuses on selling into the existing customer base rather than new business.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Familiarity with Talent Acquisition and HR tools and workflows.
- A network that includes Heads of Talent.
- Willingness to travel for company events, customer meetups, and on-sites.
- Multi-year track record of exceeding $1M+ quotas while selling complex SaaS technologies to large organizations.
- Experience closing many $100K+ ARR sales requiring consensus building and executive engagement.
- Demonstrated experience winning highly competitive opportunities by identifying pain and business impacts and connecting them to leadership-team strategic initiatives.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): US; Canada; Greater Austin, Texas, USA area; Greater Atlanta, Georgia, USA area; Greater Waterloo, Ontario, Canada area; Greater Boston area, Massachusetts; New York metropolitan area; Greater Montreal, Quebec, Canada area; Greater Ann Arbor, Michigan, USA area; Greater Toronto, Ontario, Canada area; Greater Chicago, Illinois, USA area; Greater Raleigh, North Carolina, USA area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
